name: The Westin Tokyo
positioning: The Westin Tokyo: a hotel within Yebisu Garden Place in Ebisu, steps from Ebisu Station, with European-inspired design, the Westin Garden and rooms with Tokyo Tower views
best_for: Travelers who want a quieter central Tokyo base one stop from Shibuya
Guests who want a wellness-focused stay with a garden and spa

facts.text: Ebisu is a quiet upscale area of central Tokyo, moments from Shibuya, Daikanyama, Roppongi and Tokyo Tower.
The lobby is designed around the concept of an orangery.
Room design blends European elements with the surrounding greenery.
The Westin Club, on the top floor, has views of Tokyo Tower.
Le Spa Parisien offers facial and body treatments in a classical French style.
A Run Concierge recommends routes around the hotel and leads group runs when available.
The teppanyaki restaurant serves Yebisu Beef with views of Mount Fuji.
The hotel holds Green Key eco-label certification.

highlights.text: The Westin Garden was designed by landscape artist Kazuyuki Ishihara and has 300 flower varieties, seasonal blooms and a stream.
The hotel is steps from Ebisu Station, within Yebisu Garden Place, one stop from Shibuya.
Rooms have urban views, including Tokyo Tower.
The Lounge has a 10-meter atrium with marble columns and serves afternoon tea.

considerations.text: Haneda Airport is the closest airport, about 15 kilometers away.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is slightly removed from central Tokyo tourist hubs, so major attractions need transit.
